phrase: A teenager asked a chatbot about suicide for months before her school's monitoring caught it. The same week, several countries finished writing rules for AI, from classrooms to data centers.
phraseAlternatives: For months, a teenager's chatbot talk about suicide went unflagged on her school laptop. The same week, several governments wrote new AI rules, from classrooms to data centers.
A school's AI monitor missed months of a teenager's suicide-related chatbot messages. Elsewhere, countries wrote their first AI rules, covering everything from classrooms to data centers.
It took months for a school's monitoring system to flag a student's chatbot talk about suicide. That week, countries finished new AI rules for schools and data centers.
A teenager talked to a chatbot about suicide for months before anyone noticed. The same week, governments wrote new AI rules spanning classrooms and data centers.
alt: A laptop glows quietly with a small chat bubble beside an alarm bell just beginning to ring, labeled LATE, while across the scene a tall arm reaches down and presses a yellow RULES seal onto a plain school building's front door.

brief.concept: A school laptop's alarm wakes up far too slowly beside a quiet, glowing chat bubble, while a government reaches over to stamp a brand-new rulebook onto the school's front door in the very same week.
brief.metaphor: A sleepy alarm bell finally ringing just as a government rulebook lands on the school door.

cast.who: a laptop screen glowing with a single quiet chat bubble
a round alarm bell behind the laptop, eyes shut, only now beginning to ring
a plain school building standing across the scene

brief.composition: Split scene on a single horizon line. Left half: a desk with a laptop showing one glowing chat-bubble icon on its screen, and a round alarm bell just behind it with its eyes barely opening. Right half: a plain school building with a government building's arm extending over the top of the frame to press a round rulebook seal onto the school's front door. Keep each half to two simple shapes, thin precise blueprint linework, one yellow highlight on the alarm bell and one on the rulebook seal.
